'''Holowan Labs''' was a facility of [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]] located in the [[Network Security District]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It contained a show room, where Holowan Industries was demonstrating new [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] models to their [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] clients sometime around the year [[3642 BBY]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Ryleah]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] tasked an unknown party to raid Holowan Labs and steal the battle droids' schematics for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR" />
